evidence.R1-02: round0 CO-S03 Turn 2 is scripted 'in place of a confirmation' (l.248) and is the only change scenario, so nothing triggers the row 'in the confirming turn or after confirming' (l.96) or G-02's voiding clause.
evidence.R1-03: round0 row 'did not answer the second CO-A2' (l.101) says 'no CO-A3' and CO-A4 with no lookup, but packet Round 3 Q4 says 're-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund', and CO-07 allows that handoff only when the agent 'cannot tell'.
evidence.R1-05: round0 has 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' only in the must-not list (l.49); no CO/G rule and no §5.2 dimension asserts packet Round 3 Q1 'promises nothing about when the money arrives'.
evidence.R1-06: round0: every Turn 1 except CO-S02 names an order, and CO-S02 has two open orders, so no scenario has an unnamed request with one open order to fail an agent that always asks which order.
evidence.R1-07: round0 CO-S17 row 3 (l.1037) injects 'order not cancelled' after CO-A2 returned cancelled, with Final state 'HG-10482 has status cancelled'; Appendix A defines OrderNotCancelled as 'the order is not cancelled'.
evidence.R1-08: round0 CO-07 says staff follow-up is told 'once the order system has created the task' (l.80), but 'Refund not issued reported' (l.1505) checks only content, and §5.2 has the judge read text sent alongside tool calls.
evidence.R1-10: Packet Round 3 Q3 says for 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet'; round0 row l.105 and the dimension used by CO-S20 require 'the refund has not been issued' instead.
evidence.R1-11: round0 Appendix A CO-A3 (l.1525) adds `failure_reason` with three values; the packet's refund fields are id, order number, amount, payment method, status, and l.77 says only 'returns a refund with status failed'.
evidence.R1-12: round0 CO-S02 confirmation pair (l.189) has no scope marker and no Forbidden line catches a proposal before the which-order answer, so a guessed HG-10511 proposal passes rows 1 and 3.
evidence.R1-14: round0 CO-S19/S20/S21 say the two unanswered CO-A3 'together they create' the refund (l.1120, 1177, 1236), which leaves unset what a lookup between the calls shows, though CO-06 bars a second CO-A3 after a failed refund.
evidence.R1-15: round0 'Refund status reported' (l.1507) requires 'the order is cancelled', but its row (l.105) requires only 'that status and the refund id', and no rule requires CO-S19's agent to state the cancellation.
evidence.R1-16: evaluation-checklist.md l.39 requires a User turn trigger to be a §5.1 event, never 'a proposal'; round0 CO-S03/S04 trigger on 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482' (l.248, l.308).
evidence.R1-18: round0 failure row l.94 says 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order', yet CO-S08 reference step 3 'asks whether they want to cancel the whole order'; 'propose' is never defined.
evidence.R2-01: round1 CO-08 (l.83) and the message check 'Refund id reported' require telling the refund id; the packet only says 'report that status' (l.63) and 'reports what it finds' (l.54), and no confirmed derivation adds it.
evidence.R2-02: round1 row l.107 hands off with 'reason refund not issued' after OrderNotCancelled, but CO-07 (l.80) allows CO-A4 only when 'the order is cancelled' or the agent 'cannot tell', and the latter maps to cancellation unknown.
evidence.R2-03: round1 row l.104: 'no CO-A3 or CO-A4 until a lookup made after it answers' contradicts its own last branch 'If the lookup does not answer ... make CO-A4'.
evidence.R2-04: round1 CO-S26 row 2 (l.1513) has 'placed' become 'shipped'; the only transition the packet gives is the race 'processing → shipped' (l.43).
evidence.R2-05: round1 CO-03 (l.68) requires both statements for every trigger, while row l.97 requires only the whole-order statement and row l.98 only the refund terms.
evidence.R2-06: round1 'Order asked before proposing' (l.1574) is anchored on the §5.1 'confirmation question', which excludes 'A question with the right form and one wrong value' (l.1536), so a wrong-order guess passes.
evidence.R2-09: round1 §5.2 (l.1568) states only that the judge 'reads every text the agent sends', yet definitions l.1582-1587 depend on 'after a CO-A4 returned its task id', 'the last lookup showed', and the data-variant row.
evidence.R2-11: round1 CO-S19 Forbidden 'Fewer than one CO-A1 after the second CO-A3' (l.1148) names an absence, a required read; checklist l.16/l.19: Forbidden lines name call patterns and reads are never required.
evidence.R2-12: round1 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn' (CO-S01 l.149 etc.) is undefined when no confirmation turn occurs, and §5.2 reports Forbidden lines and Required scores separately, so the score differs by reading.
evidence.R2-13: round1 G-01 'the one order the current request is about' never defines the current request, CO-06 caps per conversation, and no rule, row or scenario covers 'cancel both' in the two-open-order worlds of CO-S02/S03.
evidence.R2-14: round1 row l.97 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' has only the holding-back scenario CO-S08 (all writes Forbidden); no scenario covers the acting side.
evidence.R2-15: round1 row l.99 says 'propose the changed proposal' for a term changed in the confirming turn, which CO-03 forbids when the term is store credit or another card; row l.98 says propose only the original; no scenario decides it.
evidence.R2-17: round1 has no failure row or scenario for a lookup that returns no open order when the customer names none; cockburn-checklist requires a 'nothing found' branch.
evidence.R3-01: round2 CO-S15 reference goes from step 7 'CO-A2 → no answer' to step 8 'CO-A4' (l.940-941) with no CO-A1 between, which breaks its own Forbidden 'CO-A4 before a CO-A1 made after the second CO-A2' (l.923).
evidence.R3-02: round2 G-04 (l.27) says the agent 'repeats it only when ...', a necessary condition that grants no permission; CO-06 adds the lookup requirement, so no line lets a blind cancel resend happen.
evidence.R3-03: round2 CO-S08 pair 'Would you like to cancel the whole order HG-10530 instead?' (l.521) and step 3 offer the cancellation that row l.98 holds back ('propose nothing until the customer asks'), while CO-S27 step 3 (l.1577) does not offer it.
evidence.R3-05: round2 §5.1 l.1655 says 'text sent alongside a tool call is not' an agent message; §5.2 l.1685 has the judge read it; dimensions l.1692 and l.1699-1704 are stated in terms of 'agent message'.
evidence.R3-06: round2 Appendix A l.1715 'may repeat CO-A1 without limit' and §5.1 l.1657 ends a trial only on agent messages; CO-S10/S14/S15/S21 script CO-A1 never answering, so endless lookups never end the trial.
evidence.R3-07: round2 Appendix A l.1713 'compare case-insensitively' is a grading rule; nothing says whether cancel_order accepts 'hg-10530', so the verdict of CO-S01 row 3 (tagged canonicalization) depends on the harness.
evidence.R3-08: round2 CO-S22 l.1306 and CO-S23 l.1366 have 'status failed because <failure reason>', but after R1-11 no Appendix A result or refund field carries a cause, so the Given step cannot set it and CO-S23's rows are identical.
evidence.R3-09: Packet l.43 says 'Cancellable while placed or processing, no time limit', but no rule states it and only CO-S02 (l.186) sets placed dates, both recent, so an agent with an invented age cutoff passes every scenario.
evidence.R3-10: round2 CO-S03 (l.253-258) is the only scenario with two open orders and a named order, and no line or dimension fails an extra 'which order?'; precision is 'never folded into the score' (l.1681).
evidence.R3-12: round2 row l.92 fires on any unanswered pre-CO-A2 lookup and says 'propose nothing', with no branch for a retried lookup that answers, though reads are retried without limit (Appendix A l.1715) and CO-01 bars proposals only 'when no lookup ... has answered'.
